messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate (eu-west-1) — error spike started ~2136543180. Paging: anna (oncall).
anna (oncall): on it. can someone paste a quick summary of affected customers?
alice (prod-obs): dashboards show 5xx rate from gateway -> inference-runtime increased from 0.2% to ~8% over 3m. latency p95 up from 230ms to ~1.4s for short prompts. Affected routes: /v1/generate (text gen), /v1/embeddings (sporadic timeouts).
jordan (sre): seeing a surge of gateway 502/504s. repro with a few requests returns "upstream request timeout". Not seeing obvious CPU/GPU saturation on dedicated pools.
tara (eng-runtime): checking runtime logs... ugh traces are sparse — sampling looks disabled for the gateway cluster in eu-west-1 (TRACE_SAMPLING=0). we don't have request-id on some legacy proxy paths so a lot of requests lack trace linkage.
mike (infra): can we turn sampling on briefly? that's dangerous but worth it for debugging. also maybe route traffic to eu-central standby pool while we triage?
ops-bot: @anna auto-scaling events: gw-proxy-eu-west scaled +3 nodes at 2136543240.
anna (oncall): do it. enable sampling and add request-id header injection as a stopgap. mike, can you do the routing/fallback? tara, add temporary debug logs on runtime.
mike (infra): patching the proxy config now — enable X-Req-Id injection and bump trace sampling to 10% for eu-west. applying k8s patch:
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: gw-proxy-eu-west
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: proxy
        env:
        - name: TRACE_SAMPLING
          value: "0.1"
        - name: INJECT_REQUEST_ID
          value: "true"
```

mike (infra): rollout started (deployment/gw-proxy-eu-west) — will monitor.
tara (eng-runtime): enabling debug log level and request-id middleware in runtime hotpatch. small patch to middleware to log request_id + model_id + route for 5xx. pushing to canary.
```python
# runtime middleware snippet
if request.headers.get('X-Req-Id'):
    logger.bind(req_id=request.headers['X-Req-Id']).info('req-received', model=model_name, path=path)
```

alice (prod-obs): after enabling sampling + injection we now see trace links for ~9% of requests. initial traces show repeated upstream connection resets between gateway and runtime pool-2 nodes ~2136543275.
jordan (sre): looking at TCP metrics — retransmits on node pool-2. Could be network flakiness or a bad instance. Suggest cordon pool-2 nodes and drain traffic.
mike (infra): cordoning node pool-2 instance ip-10-0-42-17 and draining. rerouting to pool-1 and pool-3.
ops-bot: drain complete for ip-10-0-42-17 at 2136543330. healthchecks show reduced error rates on that instance.
anna (oncall): after drain, 5xx % dropped from 8% -> 1.5% over 2m. latency p95 is back down to ~300ms. good mitigation.
tara (eng-runtime): hotpatch logs show the failing requests all lack KV-cache warm hits — many are cold-starts with large seq lengths. a combination of cold-cache + network blips amplified 5xx cascade.
jordan (sre): confirming — a small subset of requests tried to establish a new upstream connection concurrently and hit a retry bug in our proxy that returned 502 instead of retrying. ticketing that.
anna (oncall): customer impact: partial for some PLG users with short prompts; a few enterprise streams timed out. ops communications: we should notify affected customers that some requests may have returned 5xx between 2136543180-2136543330, now mitigated.
alice (prod-obs): posting initial incident note to #status page with timeline and mitigation steps.
mike (infra): rolling back TRACE_SAMPLING to normal (0.01) and disabling debug logs — keep request-id injection on for now until postmortem.
ops-bot: deploys complete.
anna (oncall): action items (short-term):
- [ ] jordan: file bug for proxy retry bug + link to failing trace ids (owner: jordan).
- [ ] tara: add persistent request-id injection to runtime config + unit test (owner: tara).
- [ ] alice: backfill missing traces for the window using request logs + correlate (owner: alice).
- [ ] mike: investigate pool-2 node root cause (network or kernel) and recommend replacement plan (owner: mike).
- [ ] anna: customer comms and postmortem owner.
anna (oncall): assigning postmortem to anna and jordan. tentative sev2. we'll follow up with timeline and RCA.
jordan (sre): noted. will attach traces and logs to the incident ticket.
alice (prod-obs): small note: we relied on ephemeral sampling to debug; we should have a documented stopgap procedure for turning on sampling + request-id injection in region. I'll create a runbook entry.
tara (eng-runtime): will prepare a patch to avoid cold-cache amplification (prefetch warmers + prevent mass simultaneous KV rebuild).
anna (oncall): thanks everyone. closing thread for live mitigation, leaving ticket open for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
